title: Artificial Intelligence Powered Retail: Revolutionizing Customer Experience for a Sustainable Future
description: AI is used in retail for recommendations, stock planning, pricing, supply chains, customer service, and the line between useful and creepy.
short_description: A practical guide to recommendations, inventory, pricing, supply chains, and the point where personalisation starts feeling too personal.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A practical overview of AI in Retail for retail operators, ecommerce teams, merchandisers, and readers tracking customer experience.
